_meta.title: The Moon and the planets named in the records, in seven languages
_meta.scope: The Moon, the five planets, the five together and one of the five left unidentified. Stars, asterisms and lunar lodges are the entries of xingguan.json.
_meta.fields: key = body identifier, the value a record's object.key carries where it names one body. kind = moon, planet, or planets for the five together. token = the value of a supplied subject=<token> unit, present where the translations supply the body as the subject of a clause. alias = the names the sources write for the body, ancient, variant-glyph and modern, in the forms the texts print. zh-Hans / zh-Hant / en / fr / es / it / ja = the name as the translations print it, all seven required.
_meta.provenance: The names are the forms the translations of the record corpus print; the aliases are the names the sources of the corpus use. Original to this project.
